findings.issue: The `filter_upwards [hD.eventually_norm_sub_sub_apply_lt hDc] … cases s <;> simpa only [negPointTwistChartReading_chartAt_self ℂ hσx, …]` block is the sign-parametric merge of the proofs of `exists_negPointTwist_section_of_hasFDerivAt` (Untwist.lean:309-321) and `exists_pointTwist_section_of_hasFDerivAt` (Untwist.lean:328-340). summary: The new step in `exists_untwist_section_of_finset` that turns the derivative condition into the estimate `exists_untwist_section` needs repeats the proof of `exists_negPointTwist_section_of_hasFDerivAt` and `exists_pointTwist_section_of_hasFDerivAt` with the sign as a parameter, and these two lemmas have no other uses. The new `IsSignedTransverseZero` predicate duplicates the condition still written out inline in `exists_contMDiffSection_complexEulerClass_eq_sum_sign`.
